rules: Do not change backend, auth, middleware, DynamoDB, Cognito, NHI, patient portal, checkout, or audit logic unless explicitly scoped.
No raw NHI, encrypted NHI, NHI hash, patient email, phone, address, Cognito sub, tokens, or secrets in outputs.
No markdown docs unless explicitly requested.
Every implementation task must have allowed files, forbidden files, acceptance criteria, and verification commands.
